source_refs.note: 10. Identifying barriers to care: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 189-189.

blocks.text: Biostatistics surveys ke data aur sehat ki khidmaat ke istemal ke patterns ka analysis kar ke woh rukawatein dhoondti hai jo logon ko ilaaj tak pohanchne se rokti hain. Is se hospitals aur policy banane wale aise tareeqe banate hain jo ilaaj tak pohanch aasan karein, na-barabari kam karein, aur sehat ka nizam zyada mo'assar (efficient) aur munsifana (equitable) banayen.
